# 4 Ezra Chapter 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** 6th Ezra (Christian addition)

---

**1** Speak these prophetic words into the ears of my people — words I am putting in your mouth, says the LORD.

**2** Have them written down on paper; they are trustworthy and true.

**3** Do not be afraid of what people are plotting against you. Don't let the skepticism of those who oppose you shake you.

**4** Every unbeliever will die in their unbelief.

**5** Behold — says the LORD — I am sending evils upon the world: sword, famine, death, and destruction.

**6** Because iniquity has contaminated the entire earth, and their destructive deeds have run their full course.

**7** Therefore the LORD says:

**8** I will no longer stay silent about their godless acts, the wickedness they commit and endure. Hear me: the blood of the innocent and the righteous is crying out to me, and the souls of the righteous never stop crying out.

**9** I will absolutely avenge them, says the LORD. I will gather to myself every drop of innocent blood from among them.

**10** Look — my people are being led like a flock to slaughter. I will not allow them to remain in the land of Egypt.

**11** I will bring them out with a powerful hand and a raised arm. I will strike Egypt with plagues just as I did before and destroy all her land.

**12** Let Egypt mourn — she and her foundations — for the plague of punishment God is bringing down on her.

**13** Let the farmers mourn, for their crops will fail from blight and hail and catastrophic weather.

**14** Woe to the world and everyone in it!

**15** For sword and destruction are on their way, and nation will rise against nation in armed conflict.

**16** There will be upheaval everywhere. People will defy their kings and reject their leaders, driven by their own strength.

**17** A person will want to enter a city and not be able to.

**18** Because of their arrogance, cities will be thrown into chaos, houses will be torn down, and people will live in terror.

**19** No one will show compassion to a neighbor; houses will be raided at swordpoint and looted for food, driven by hunger and desperate suffering.

**20** Behold, says my God, I am summoning all the earth's kings to fear me — from the rising sun, from the south, from the east, and from Lebanon —

**21** turning them against each other, so they receive back what they have given.

**22** What they are doing now to my chosen people, I will do to them — I will repay them in full. Thus says the LORD God:

**23** My right hand will not spare sinners, and my sword will not rest over those who shed innocent blood on the earth.

**24** Fire has gone out from his wrath and consumed the earth's foundations and the sinners with it — like straw burning up.

**25** Woe to those who sin and ignore my commandments! says the LORD.

**26** I will not spare them. Go your way, rebellious children — do not defile my sanctuary.

**27** For the LORD knows every one who sins against him, and that is precisely why he hands them over to death and destruction.

**28** The calamities have arrived upon the whole earth. You will remain in them. God will not rescue you, because you sinned against him.

**29** Watch — a terrifying vision is coming from the east!

**30** The dragon nations of Arabia will march out with vast fleets of chariots, their armies rushing across the earth like the wind, filling everyone who hears them with fear and dread.

**31** The Carmonians, burning with rage, will charge out like wild boars from a forest. With overwhelming force they will engage in battle and devastate part of the Assyrian territory.

**32** Then the dragons will gain the upper hand, true to their nature. If they turn together and unite their power to pursue them,

**33** the others will panic, go quiet before their power, and flee.

**34** From the Assyrian homeland the enemy will set a trap and destroy some of them. Fear and trembling will grip their army and paralysis will strike their kings.

**35** Watch — terrible storm clouds from the east, from the north, and from the south, horrible to see, charged with wrath and tempest.

**36** They will strike each other and hurl a great storm of fire down on the earth — the fire of their very own stars; blood will flow from sword point to gut,

**37** with filth of battle reaching as high as a camel's knee.

**38** Great terror and trembling will spread across the earth. Everyone who witnesses that fury will be overcome with fear; trembling will seize them all.

**39** After this, powerful storms will be stirred up from south and north and still another front from the west.

**40** Then mighty east winds will rise and block everything in. The cloud he raised up in wrath, and the star that was stirred to terrorize from east to west, will be destroyed.

**41** There will be vast, violent storm clouds full of rage, and a star, to terrify the whole earth and everyone on it. Over every high and prominent place they will pour down a horrifying fire-star,

**42** fire and hail and flying swords and massive floods, until every field is swamped and every river overflows.

**43** They will tear down cities and walls, mountains and hills, forests and meadows and grain fields.

**44** They will climb all the way to heaven, and stars will begin to fall, and great lamentation will fill the heavens as the stars are shaken to their foundations.

**45** Then a great dread will come upon them from the east: the great powerful dragon, coming in the fury of his spirit, leading with a wall of flame.

**46** Wherever he passes, devastation will follow; what is left behind will also be consumed. When people see him coming they will be paralyzed with fear.

**47** The cities of Egypt — not all but many — will come together, trembling and terrified before him, bringing him incense and gifts.

**48** And he will terrify them with his fury, so that they go away in a peace born of fear.

**49** A massive storm will sweep across the sea; the waves will be in turmoil, and even the fish, before the face of the LORD and the blaze of his power.

**50** For fear and trembling will be everywhere on earth. Everyone who sees his wrath will shake, seized by trembling.

**51** Then great clouds will gather and billow with fury, and the star will advance and fill the whole earth with terror. Everyone living on it will tremble, and no quiet place will be found anywhere.

**52** War will break out everywhere. Every person will be holding a weapon.

**53** Those who fear God will not need armor — they will escape like clouds driven by wind and hail. But the wicked will be destroyed and consumed like fire burning them up.

**54** Woe to those who sin and ignore my commandments! says the LORD.

**55** I will not bother to rescue them — I am bringing evil on those who disobeyed God's law.

**56** Here is my judgment against them: I will drive them wailing into the desert and leave them there.

**57** Their bones will be scattered across the plain. There will be no healing for them — thus says the LORD.

**58** Just as fire burns the stubble to nothing, so you will be left with nothing.

**59** And you who have been arrogant toward those who fear God — hear my word now:

**60** The LORD is ready to destroy you. A sword is pointed at you. If you cannot see the vision written against you, it is only because God is patient in his anger and his grace is immense.

**61** No one escapes the judgment of the Most High — no one except those who keep his commandments.

**62** And so, you who have been so proud against those who fear God, hear what the LORD God says:

**63** I will bring disaster on all those who have hated my people. In a single day I will destroy every land the wicked have defiled with their power.
